==Purpose==
Template for reporting false positives at [[Wookieepedia:Spamfilter problems]]. Loaded automatically on that page via [[Template:False positive/preload]]. Editintro is at [[Template:False positive/editintro]].

==Usage==
<pre>
{{subst:False positive
|username=
|page=
|description=

}}
</pre>

*<code>|username=</code> Username of the editor whose edit is being reported. If not provided, defaults to the user filing the report.
*<code>|page=</code> Page that you (or the editor whose edit was stopped) were trying to edit when the false positive occurred.
*<code>|description=</code> Description of what you were trying to do.
